implemented: Computes one-sided lower confidence bounds for daily net alpha and after-cost portfolio utility using a frozen Newey-West dependence policy.
A positive point estimate with a nonpositive lower bound is never labeled CONFIRMED.
Incomplete scheduled samples retain the full denominator and withhold bounds; unscheduled and non-finite observations are rejected.
Degenerate zero-variance samples cannot produce a zero-width confirmation.
Allocates the dependence-policy familywise alpha across both reported metrics and the number of pre-registered looks using Bonferroni one-sided lower bounds.

Adds registered_confirmation_bounds, which resolves the durable frozen cohort, re-derives the sample-size plan, verifies policy/cohort schedule and timestamps, and checks every reported session against its stored digest.
Withholds confidence bounds with SAMPLE_SIZE_NOT_MET when the scheduled cohort length is below the calculated required sample.
